text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6c7774

g.text: Controls share the origin stage and night. Each person has equal weight; intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6c7774

g.text: Whole-night scaling is used only for this effect-size analysis. Morphology candidates are not clinically validated events.
